name: Dylan Johnson
current_role: Assistant Secretary of State for Global Public Affairs (since January 2026); communications lead, National Security Council
summary: Dylan Johnson became the State Department’s assistant secretary for global public affairs on January 26, 2026, while continuing to lead communications for the National Security Council at the White House, which Rubio also runs as national security adviser.
